listings.name: Christmas Bow
listings.title: Christmas Bow Hand Embroidery Pattern PDF, Holiday Hoop Art for Beginners, Cozy December Stitching, 6 and 8 Inch Hoops, Download
listings.description:
Stitch a classic Christmas bow with this beginner-friendly hand embroidery pattern — a clean, modern line design of a looped ribbon bow with long trailing tails, perfect for cozy December evenings and simple, relaxing stitching. Hang it as holiday hoop art, add it to your seasonal gift corner, or stitch it onto linens for the season.

What you'll receive (digital download)
- 2 high-resolution PDF embroidery patterns (black-and-white line art), sized for 6 inch and 8 inch round hoops.
- Printable designs you can trace or transfer to your favorite fabric.
- Digital files only; no physical item will be shipped.

Skill level
- Great for beginners and up who enjoy easy, relaxing embroidery patterns.
- Use your favorite colors and basic stitches to make the bow your own — traditional red, or whatever suits your holiday palette.

How it works
- Purchase this listing from WatermarkandHue on Etsy (etsy.com/shop/WatermarkandHue).
- Download your PDF embroidery patterns from your Etsy account.
- Print or transfer the design to fabric.
- Start stitching!

Stitching more than one? All four classic motifs — bow, candy canes, nutcracker, and poinsettia — come together in the Christmas Classics set in our shop: four patterns for less than the price of three.
